case_title: Mst. Asia Bibi v. The State (3-Member Bench)
ratio_decidendi: In offences under Section 295-C PPC carrying capital punishment, the prosecution must establish the charge beyond any shadow of reasonable doubt with unimpeachable, pristine evidence. Unexplained delay in lodging the FIR, contradictory ocular statements, and failure to comply with mandatory investigation by an officer not below the rank of Superintendent of Police (SP) under Section 156-A CrPC entitles the accused to complete acquittal. The golden rule of Islamic jurisprudence dictates that an error in acquittal is far better than an error in conviction.
facts_summary: Appellant was convicted under Section 295-C PPC based on alleged oral altercation in a field. FIR was lodged after an unexplained delay of 5 days following village panchayat deliberations. Supreme Court held evidence was full of material contradictions and acquitted the appellant.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 295-C تعزیرات پاکستان کے تحت توہینِ رسالت کے الزام میں استغاثہ پر لازم ہے کہ وہ بغیر کسی ادنیٰ شبہ کے ناقابلِ تردید ثبوت پیش کرے۔ ایف آئی آر میں غیر واضح تاخیر اور گواہوں کے بیانات میں تضاد کی صورت میں ملزم شک کے فائدے پر مکمل بریت کا حقدار ہے۔

case_title: Malik Muhammad Mumtaz Qadri v. The State
ratio_decidendi: No individual has the right or authority under the Constitution, law, or Islamic jurisprudence to take the law into their own hands and execute a person upon a self-assessed allegation of blasphemy (Toheen-e-Risalat). Any extrajudicial killing under the garb of religious provocation constitutes Qatl-i-Amd punishable under Section 302 PPC and terrorism under Section 7 of the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997.
facts_summary: Police guard assassinated a provincial Governor claiming moral/religious provocation. The Supreme Court upheld capital conviction under Section 302 PPC and ATA 1997, affirming supremacy of rule of law.
urdu_ratio: کسی شخص کو قانون ہاتھ میں لے کر توہینِ مذہب کے الزام پر خود ساختہ سزا دینے یا قتل کرنے کا کوئی اختیار حاصل نہیں۔ ایسا اقدام تعزیرات پاکستان کی دفعہ 302 اور انسداد دہشت گردی ایکٹ کے تحت سنگین جرم ہے۔

case_title: Muhammad Mahboob alias Booba v. The State
ratio_decidendi: To sustain a conviction under Section 295-C PPC, intentional and deliberate use of derogatory remarks (Mens Rea) must be proved to the highest standard of certainty. Vague, generalized allegations without verbatim reproduction of alleged words during investigation and trial cannot form the basis of conviction in a capital offence.
facts_summary: Accused was charged under Section 295-C PPC based on generalized witness claims without specific context or proof of deliberate intention.
urdu_ratio: دفعہ 295-C کے تحت جرم ثابت کرنے کے لیے ملزم کی دانستہ اور بدنیتی پر مبنی نیت (Mens Rea) اور توہین آمیز الفاظ کا ہو بہو اور ٹھوس ثبوت ہونا لازمی ہے۔

case_title: Salamat Mansha Masih v. The State
ratio_decidendi: Compliance with Section 156-A CrPC (mandating that no officer below the rank of Superintendent of Police shall investigate a case under Section 295-C PPC) is statutory and imperative. Investigation conducted by a Sub-Inspector or ASI in violation of Section 156-A CrPC renders the prosecution case doubtful and entitles the accused to bail under Section 497(2) CrPC.
facts_summary: Petitioner was arrested under Section 295-C PPC and the entire investigation was conducted by an ASI. Supreme Court granted post-arrest bail due to statutory violation of Section 156-A CrPC.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 156-A ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت توہینِ رسالت (295-C) کے مقدمات کی تفتیش ایس پی (SP) رینک سے کم افسر نہیں کر سکتا۔ اس قانون کی خلاف ورزی تفتیش کو مشکوک بناتی ہے اور ضمانت کا جواز فراہم کرتی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Under Section 196 CrPC, no court can take cognizance of an offence under Section 295-A PPC (deliberate and malicious acts intended to outrage religious feelings) without the prior complaint or sanction of the Federal or Provincial Government. Prosecution initiated without statutory sanction under Section 196 CrPC is void ab initio.
facts_summary: FIR was registered directly under Section 295-A PPC without obtaining government sanction. Supreme Court quashed cognizance taken without compliance with Section 196 CrPC.
urdu_ratio: دفعہ 295-A تعزیرات پاکستان کے تحت مقدمہ چلانے کے لیے سیکشن 196 ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت وفاقی یا صوبائی حکومت کی باقاعدہ منظوری (Sanction) ناگزیر ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Where evidence discloses that a complaint under Section 295-C PPC was motivated by an ongoing land or property dispute between the complainant and the accused, and independent witnesses from the locality are not produced, the charge cannot be deemed proven beyond reasonable doubt.
facts_summary: Blasphemy charge arose during heated land evacuation conflict. Supreme Court found complainant had financial motive to falsely implicate the accused.
urdu_ratio: اگر توہینِ مذہب کا الزام جائیداد کے تنازع یا ذاتی دشمنی کے پس منظر میں لگایا گیا ہو اور غیر جانبدار گواہ موجود نہ ہوں، تو ملزم کو شک کا فائدہ دیتے ہوئے بری کیا جائے گا۔

ratio_decidendi: An unexplained delay of over 24 hours in lodging the First Information Report (FIR) in a capital offence (Section 302 PPC) raises genuine suspicion of deliberation, consultation, and false implication. Such unexplained delay entitles the accused to the concession of post-arrest bail under Section 497(2) CrPC as a case of further inquiry.
facts_summary: Homicide case under Section 302/34 PPC. Occurrence took place in daylight, yet FIR registered after 36 hours without explanation.
urdu_ratio: قتل کے مقدمے میں ایف آئی آر کے اندراج میں بغیر کسی معقول وجہ کے 24 گھنٹے سے زیادہ تاخیر ملزم کو سیکشن 497(2) ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت ضمانت کا حقدار بناتی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Grant of bail in non-bailable offences not falling within the prohibitory clause of Section 497(1) CrPC is a matter of right and refusal is an exception. Pre-trial incarceration cannot be converted into advance punishment.
facts_summary: Landmark ruling establishing cardinal principles of bail in non-prohibitory clause offences under Pakistani law.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 497(1) ضابطہ فوجداری کی امتناعی شق سے باہر جرائم میں ضمانت اصول ہے اور انکار استثناء۔ ملزم کو قبل از وقت سزا کے طور پر قید نہیں رکھا جا سکتا۔

case_title: Shahzada Qaiser Arfat v. The State
ratio_decidendi: For grant of pre-arrest bail under Section 498 CrPC, the applicant must establish ulterior motives, malice, or mala fides on the part of complainant or police to cause unjustified incarceration and humiliation.
facts_summary: Petitioner sought confirmation of pre-arrest bail in a property dispute where criminal FIR was registered to exert pressure.
urdu_ratio: قبل از گرفتاری ضمانت (سیکشن 498) کے لیے مدعی یا پولیس کی بدنیتی (Mala Fide) اور تذلیل کا ارادہ ثابت ہونا لازمی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Under the third proviso to Section 497(1) CrPC, continuous custody exceeding two years in capital offences without conclusion of trial entitles the accused to statutory bail as of right, provided delay is not occasioned by the accused.
facts_summary: Accused remained behind bars for over 26 months without conclusion of trial due to prosecution witness non-appearance.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 497(1) کے تحت اگر ملزم مسلسل 2 سال سے زائد جیل میں ہو اور تاخیر اس کی وجہ سے نہ ہو، تو وہ قانونی حق پر ضمانت کا حقدار ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Strong, cogent, and overwhelming evidence is required for cancellation of bail under Section 497(5) CrPC. Once granted by a competent court, bail cannot be recalled lightly unless the order is arbitrary or the accused misuses liberty by tampering with evidence.
facts_summary: Complainant sought cancellation of bail. Supreme Court dismissed application due to lack of witness intimidation evidence.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 497(5) کے تحت ضمانت خارج کرنے کے لیے ٹھوس شواہد ضروری ہیں۔ ایک بار ملنے والی ضمانت معمولی باتوں پر منسوخ نہیں کی جا سکتی۔

case_title: Mst. Shazia Bibi v. The State
ratio_decidendi: Under the first proviso to Section 497(1) CrPC, women accused, minors under 16 years, and sick or infirm persons are entitled to special statutory concession of bail even in capital offences, absent exceptional heinous brutality.
facts_summary: Female petitioner charged with abetment under Section 302/109 PPC behind bars with infant child granted post-arrest bail.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 497(1) کی پہلی شق کے تحت خواتین، 16 سال سے کم بچوں اور بیمار افراد کو قتل جیسے سنگین مقدمات میں بھی ضمانت کی خصوصی رعایت حاصل ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: In offences under Section 324 PPC (attempted murder) where injuries caused do not fall under Section 337-D (Jaifah) or Section 337-F(v), the maximum imprisonment does not fall within the prohibitory clause of Section 497(1) CrPC, making bail normal rule.
facts_summary: Petitioner charged under 324 PPC for causing simple firearm injury on non-vital part granted post-arrest bail.
urdu_ratio: اقدامِ قتل (دفعہ 324) میں اگر چوٹ غیر مہلک حصے پر ہو تو سزا امتناعی شق میں نہیں آتی اور ضمانت منظور کرنا عمومی اصول ہے۔

case_title: Mirza Shaukat Baig v. Shahid Jamil
ratio_decidendi: Pre-arrest bail under Section 498 CrPC is an extraordinary relief intended solely to protect innocent citizens from arrest based on malicious prosecution or tainted police motives. It cannot be used to bypass regular criminal investigation.
facts_summary: Petitioner failed to produce any proof of personal grudge or police malice. Supreme Court recalled ad-interim pre-arrest bail.
urdu_ratio: قبل از گرفتاری ضمانت ایک غیر معمولی رعایت ہے جو صرف جھوٹے مقدمات اور پولیس کی بدنیتی سے بچاؤ کے لیے دی جاتی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: In cases of cross-version / counter-FIR where both parties sustain injuries in a sudden free fight and it cannot be determined at bail stage as to who was the aggressor, the case squarely falls within Section 497(2) CrPC as one of further inquiry, entitling accused on both sides to bail.
facts_summary: Cross-FIR registered by both factions for same clash where persons from both sides were wounded.
urdu_ratio: مخالف فریقین کے کراس مقدمات (Cross-Version) میں جب یہ طے نہ ہو سکے کہ پہل کس نے کی، تو معاملہ مزید انکوائری کا بنتا ہے اور ضمانت دی جائے گی۔

statutes_cited: Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997 - Section 9
ratio_decidendi: In narcotic cases, if the prosecution fails to establish unbroken chain of custody and safe transmission of recovered substance to the chemical examiner without delay, case falls within purview of further inquiry under Section 497(2) CrPC.
facts_summary: Contraband kept in police custody for 14 days without explanation before dispatch to forensic science agency.
urdu_ratio: منشیات کے مقدمات میں اگر لیبارٹری کو نمونے بھیجنے کا محفوظ ریکارڈ (Chain of Custody) موجود نہ ہو تو ضمانت منظور کی جائے گی۔

ratio_decidendi: Offence under Section 489-F PPC carrying maximum punishment of three years does not fall within prohibitory clause of Section 497(1) CrPC. Withholding bail in cheque dishonor cases as a recovery tool is illegal.
facts_summary: Trial court refused bail to force settlement of business dues. High Court granted bail declaring detention cannot be debt collection measure.
urdu_ratio: چیک ڈس آنر (489-F) کا جرم امتناعی شق میں نہیں آتا۔ رقم کی وصولی کے لیے ملزم کی ضمانت روکنا غیر قانونی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Mere attribution of ineffective firing or simple lalkara (verbal exhortation) without any active overt act in a Section 302/34 PPC case entitles accused to concession of bail under further inquiry.
facts_summary: Petitioner was attributed only verbal instigation while principal co-accused fired fatal shot. Supreme Court granted bail.
urdu_ratio: قتل کے مقدمے میں صرف للکارا مارنے یا ہوائی فائرنگ کرنے کے الزام پر ملزم کو ضمانت بعد از گرفتاری دی جا سکتی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: In white-collar and fraud cases based entirely on documentary evidence, once the investigation is complete and challan is submitted under Section 173 CrPC, custody of accused serves no useful purpose.
facts_summary: Bank officer accused of fraudulent transactions granted bail after completion of investigation.
urdu_ratio: دستاویزی ثبوت اور فراڈ کے مقدمات میں تفتیش مکمل اور چالان جمع ہونے کے بعد ملزم کو جیل میں رکھنے کا کوئی جواز نہیں۔

ratio_decidendi: Where un-named accused in a robbery FIR is not put to an identification parade under Article 22 of Qanun-e-Shahadat Order within reasonable time, subsequent recovery of robbed property without independent witnesses becomes doubtful, justifying bail.
facts_summary: Robbery FIR against unknown persons; identification parade conducted after 22 days delay. Bail granted.
urdu_ratio: ڈکیتی کے نامعلوم ملزم کی شناخت پریڈ میں غیر معقول تاخیر ملزم کو ضمانت کا حقدار بناتی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Under the Juvenile Justice System Act and Section 497(1) CrPC, a juvenile under 18 years of age is entitled to be released on bail unless there appear reasonable grounds for believing that the release is likely to bring him into association with criminals.
facts_summary: 15-year-old accused charged in a violent clash granted bail on statutory grounds of juvenility.
urdu_ratio: 18 سال سے کم عمر نابالغ ملزم کو جووینائل جسٹس سسٹم اور ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت ضمانت پر رہا کیا جانا لازمی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: At the bail stage, court is only required to make a tentative assessment of the material available on record. Deep appreciation of evidence or recording findings on merits is prohibited as it prejudices trial.
facts_summary: Supreme Court cautioned lower courts against premature findings on guilt or innocence during bail hearings.
urdu_ratio: ضمانت کے مرحلے پر عدالت صرف سرسری جائزہ (Tentative Assessment) لے سکتی ہے، گواہیوں کا گہرا تجزیہ کرنا منع ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Where there is an irreconcilable conflict between ocular testimony (eye-witness statements) and medical evidence regarding distance of firing, nature of injuries, or time of death in Section 302 PPC cases, benefit of doubt must inevitably be extended to accused, resulting in acquittal.
facts_summary: Eye-witnesses claimed accused shot deceased from point-blank range, whereas post-mortem showed absence of charring/blackening.
urdu_ratio: قتل کے مقدمے میں چشم دید گواہوں کے بیانات اور میڈیکل رپورٹ میں تضاد کی صورت میں شک کا فائدہ لازمی طور پر ملزم کو ملے گا۔

ratio_decidendi: To award death penalty as Qisas under Section 302(a) PPC, strict standard of proof under Article 17 of Qanun-e-Shahadat Order, 1984 (Tazkiya-tul-Shahood) must be satisfied. Where proof required for Qisas is lacking, punishment can only be awarded under Section 302(b) PPC as Tazir.
facts_summary: Supreme Court distinguished evidentiary thresholds required for imposing death as Qisas versus Tazir under Pakistani law.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 302(a) کے تحت قصاص کی سزا کے لیے تزکیۃ الشہود کا سخت معیار درکار ہے، ورنہ سزا 302(b) کے تحت تعزیر کے طور پر دی جائے گی۔

ratio_decidendi: Recovery of the crime weapon at the instance of the accused under Article 27 QSO is merely a corroborative piece of evidence and cannot be treated as substantive evidence to sustain conviction under Section 302 PPC when primary ocular evidence is discarded.
facts_summary: Prosecution relied solely on pistol recovery after eyewitnesses were found untrustworthy. Supreme Court set aside conviction.
urdu_ratio: آلۂ قتل کی برآمدگی محض تائیدی ثبوت ہے، اگر بنیادی چشم دید گواہ غیر معتبر قرار پائیں تو صرف برآمدگی پر سزا نہیں ہو سکتی۔

case_title: Nadeem alias Deemi v. The State
ratio_decidendi: Under Sections 96 to 106 PPC, when an accused acts in exercise of right of private defence against reasonable apprehension of death or grievous hurt, causing death does not constitute murder. Exceeding defence right without premeditation falls under Section 302(c) PPC rather than capital punishment under 302(b).
facts_summary: Accused attacked with sharp weapons retaliated with licensed firearm. Supreme Court reduced sentence to Section 302(c) PPC.
urdu_ratio: دفاعِ خود اختیاری (Private Defence) کے تحت جان کے خطرے پر جوابی کارروائی قتلِ عمد نہیں، اور حد سے تجاوز پر سزا دفعہ 302(c) میں آئے گی۔

ratio_decidendi: Witnesses who deliberately depose falsely or concoct false evidence in criminal trials must be prosecuted for perjury under Section 193/194 PPC. The rule of sifting chaff from grain does not permit deliberate perjury to pollute justice.
facts_summary: Eyewitness in double murder trial proven to have perjured regarding presence at scene. Supreme Court directed perjury proceedings.
urdu_ratio: عدالت میں جھوٹی گواہی دینے والے گواہوں کے خلاف سیکشن 193 اور 194 کے تحت جھوٹی گواہی (Perjury) کا مقدمہ چلانا لازمی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Motive in a murder case is a double-edged weapon. While it may provide reason for the accused to commit crime, it equally provides reason for complainant to falsely implicate accused. Failure to prove alleged motive cuts against prosecution.
facts_summary: Prosecution set up specific motive but failed to lead evidence to substantiate it. Supreme Court acquitted accused.
urdu_ratio: قتل کے مقدمے میں محرک (Motive) دو دھاری تلوار ہے۔ اگر استغاثہ محرک ثابت کرنے میں ناکام رہے تو یہ ملزم کے حق میں جاتا ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: A dying declaration recorded under Article 46 QSO is admissible without oath or cross-examination, but conviction can only be based upon it if it is proved that deceased was in a fit mental state to depose and it is corroborated by medical evidence.
facts_summary: Dying declaration recorded without doctor's certificate of mental fitness rejected by Supreme Court.
urdu_ratio: مرتے وقت کا بیان (Dying Declaration) تب ہی معتبر مانا جائے گا جب ڈاکٹر کی تصدیق ہو کہ زخمی بیان دینے کے ہوش و حواس میں تھا۔

ratio_decidendi: Conviction in a capital murder case can be sustained on the solitary testimony of a single eyewitness only if such witness is wholly reliable and of unimpeachable character. If the witness has an interest in the dispute, uncorroborated single testimony cannot sustain death penalty.
facts_summary: Solitary interested eyewitness contradicted on material points. Supreme Court set aside death sentence.
urdu_ratio: قتل کے مقدمے میں صرف ایک گواہ کی گواہی پر سزائے موت تب ہی دی جا سکتی ہے جب وہ گواہ مکمل طور پر غیر جانبدار اور بے داغ ہو۔

ratio_decidendi: Under Section 345 CrPC and Section 338-E PPC, an offence of Qatl-i-Amd punishable under Section 302(a) or (b) PPC can be compounded by the legal heirs of the deceased (Walies) through compromise (Sulh). Once valid compromise is accepted by court, accused is entitled to acquittal unless Tazir under Section 311 PPC applies.
facts_summary: All legal heirs of deceased executed valid compromise deed. Supreme Court acquitted appellant following verification of legal heirs.
urdu_ratio: قتل کے مقدمے میں مقتول کے قانونی ورثاء (Walies) راضی نامہ کر سکتے ہیں، جس کی عدالت سے توثیق کے بعد ملزم بری ہو جاتا ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Common intention under Section 34 PPC implies pre-arranged plan and acting in concert pursuant to such plan. Mere presence at scene of crime without sharing common intention or performing an overt act does not attract vicarious liability for capital murder.
facts_summary: Co-accused accompanied principal offender to market without knowledge that principal carried a concealed pistol. Acquitted of murder charge.
urdu_ratio: دفعہ 34 (مشترکہ نیت) کے لیے پیشگی منصوبہ بندی ضروری ہے۔ موقع پر محض موجود ہونے سے قتل کی مشترکہ ذمہ داری عائد نہیں ہوتی۔

case_title: Sughran Bibi v. The State (Larger Bench)
ratio_decidendi: There can be only one First Information Report (FIR) in respect of one occurrence. Registration of a second or subsequent FIR regarding same incident is illegal and without jurisdiction. Any counter-version or subsequent statement must be recorded under Section 161 CrPC during same investigation.
facts_summary: 7-member larger bench of Supreme Court authoritative ruling resolving law on multiple FIRs in single criminal occurrence.
urdu_ratio: ایک ہی وقوعے کی دوسری ایف آئی آر درج نہیں کی جا سکتی۔ مخالف فریق کا نیا مؤقف سیکشن 161 ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت درج کیا جائے گا۔

case_title: Khizer Hayat v. Inspector General of Police (IGP) Punjab
ratio_decidendi: The Ex-Officio Justice of Peace under Section 22-A / 22-B CrPC performs administrative/quasi-judicial functions to ensure police register FIR upon disclosure of cognizable offence. However, Justice of Peace cannot direct police how to investigate or supervise investigation.
facts_summary: Supreme Court laid down definitive jurisdictional boundaries for Sessions Judges acting as Ex-Officio Justice of Peace under Section 22-A CrPC.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 22-A کے تحت جسٹس آف پیس قابلِ دست اندازی جرم پر پولیس کو ایف آئی آر درج کرنے کا حکم دے سکتا ہے مگر تفتیش میں مداخلت نہیں کر سکتا۔

ratio_decidendi: Statements of witnesses recorded under Section 161 CrPC with unexplained delay of several days after incident lose evidentiary value. Delayed recording of 161 statements implies fabrication and consultation.
facts_summary: Police recorded eyewitness statements 12 days after crime without justification. Supreme Court discarded testimony.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 161 کے تحت گواہوں کے بیانات قلمبند کرنے میں غیر معقول تاخیر گواہی کی قانونی حیثیت ختم کر دیتی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: A judicial confession recorded under Section 164 CrPC is valid only if all statutory safeguards (giving time to reflect, removal of handcuffs, warning that accused is not bound to confess) are strictly observed by Magistrate. Retracted confession without independent corroboration cannot sustain capital sentence.
facts_summary: Magistrate recorded 164 confession without removing police escort from courtroom. Confession held inadmissible.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 164 کے تحت اعترافِ جرم تب ہی جائز ہے جب مجسٹریٹ تمام قانونی تقاضے (ہتھکڑی کھولنا، سوچنے کا وقت دینا) پورے کرے۔

ratio_decidendi: A Magistrate considering police challan report under Section 173 CrPC is not bound by police opinion regarding guilt or innocence. Magistrate can disagree with police report placing accused in Column No. 2 and summon him for trial or discharge him under Section 63 CrPC upon judicial scrutiny.
facts_summary: Magistrate summoned accused placed in Column No. 2 (innocent) by police. High Court upheld Magistrate's judicial discretion.
urdu_ratio: مجسٹریٹ پولیس کی چالان رپورٹ (سیکشن 173) کا پابند نہیں اور وہ اپنے عدالتی اختیار سے ملزم کو طلب یا ڈسچارج کر سکتا ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Under Section 100 CrPC, a Magistrate has summary powers to issue search warrant for recovery of persons wrongfully confined. Section 491 CrPC empowers High Court to issue directions in nature of habeas corpus to liberate citizens illegally detained in private or police custody.
facts_summary: Citizen detained in illegal private jail at brick kiln recovered pursuant to High Court Section 491 bailiff raid.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 100 اور 491 ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت غیر قانونی حراست میں رکھے گئے افراد کو فوری بازیاب کروا کر رہا کرنے کا اختیار ہے۔

case_title: Mian Allah Ditta v. The State
ratio_decidendi: To constitute an offence under Section 489-F PPC, the prosecution must prove two indispensable ingredients: (i) the cheque was issued with dishonest intent, and (ii) it was issued towards repayment of a loan or fulfillment of an existing obligation. A post-dated cheque issued merely as guarantee or security in a business transaction does not automatically attract criminal liability under Section 489-F PPC.
facts_summary: Dispute over dishonored cheque issued as collateral security in commercial contract. Supreme Court granted bail emphasizing civil nature of dispute.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 489-F کے تحت جرم ثابت کرنے کے لیے بدنیتی اور قرض کی واپسی لازمی عنصر ہیں۔ محض سیکیورٹی یا گارنٹی کے چیک پر فوجداری مقدمہ نہیں بنتا۔

ratio_decidendi: Where allegations in the FIR, even if taken at face value, disclose a purely civil dispute arising out of breach of contract without any fraudulent or dishonest inception, the criminal machinery cannot be invoked to arm-twist the other party. In such cases, High Court is bound to quash FIR under Section 561-A CrPC to prevent abuse of process of court.
facts_summary: Complainant lodged FIR under Section 420 PPC for non-delivery of goods under commercial agreement. High Court quashed proceedings.
urdu_ratio: اگر تنازع خالصتاً دیوانی (Civil) معاہدے کی خلاف ورزی کا ہو تو سیکشن 561-A کے تحت ایف آئی آر خارج (Quash) کی جائے گی۔

ratio_decidendi: To establish cheating under Section 420 PPC, prosecution must prove dishonest intention existed at the very inception of transaction. Subsequent inability to perform contract or refund money does not transform civil liability into criminal cheating.
facts_summary: Property dealer failed to deliver plot possession due to development delay. Supreme Court held breach of promise without initial fraudulent intent is not 420 PPC.
urdu_ratio: دھوکہ دہی (دفعہ 420) کے لیے ضروری ہے کہ نیت ابتدا ہی سے بدنیتی پر مبنی ہو۔ بعد میں معاہدہ پورا نہ کر سکنا فوجداری جرم نہیں۔

ratio_decidendi: In offences under Section 468 and 471 PPC (forgery for purpose of cheating and using forged document as genuine), prosecution must prove who forged document and that accused used it with knowledge that it was forged. Expert forensic report from examiner of questioned documents is essential.
facts_summary: Disputed property sale deed; no forensic comparison of questioned signatures conducted. Conviction set aside.
urdu_ratio: جعلسازی (دفعات 468 و 471) ثابت کرنے کے لیے فرانزک ماہر کی رپورٹ اور یہ ثابت کرنا ضروری ہے کہ ملزم جانتا تھا کہ دستاویز جعلی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Where evidence shows complainant was aware at time of receiving cheque that account was dormant or closed and cheque was taken as security, ingredients of Section 489-F PPC are negated, warranting acquittal under Section 249-A CrPC.
facts_summary: Trial court dismissed Section 249-A application; High Court reversed and acquitted accused.
urdu_ratio: اگر مدعی کو معلوم تھا کہ کھاتہ بند ہے اور چیک سیکیورٹی کے طور پر لیا گیا تھا، تو دفعہ 249-A کے تحت بریت بنتی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: The distinction between simple theft (Section 379 PPC) and robbery (Section 392 PPC) hinges on violence or threat of violence. Theft becomes robbery under Section 390 PPC if in committing theft, offender causes or attempts to cause death, hurt, wrongful restraint, or instant fear thereof.
facts_summary: Accused snatched motorcycle at gunpoint. Display of firearm constitutes robbery under Section 392 PPC.
urdu_ratio: چوری (Section 379) ڈکیتی (Section 392) میں تب بدلتی ہے جب مال چھینتے وقت اسلحہ، تشدد یا خوف کا استعمال کیا جائے۔

ratio_decidendi: In dacoity cases under Section 395 PPC committed by five or more masked or un-named persons, identification parade conducted under Article 22 QSO before a Magistrate with dummies of similar physical features is substantive safeguard. Failure to describe role of each accused during parade vitiates identification.
facts_summary: Witnesses identified accused jointly without specifying who held weapon or took cash. Supreme Court set aside dacoity conviction.
urdu_ratio: ڈکیتی (395) کے مقدمات میں شناخت پریڈ کے دوران ہر ملزم کا مخصوص کردار بتانا ضروری ہے، مشترکہ شناخت غیر قانونی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: To convict under Section 411 PPC (dishonestly receiving stolen property), prosecution must prove: (1) property was stolen, (2) it was recovered from conscious possession of accused, and (3) accused received it knowing or having reason to believe it was stolen.
facts_summary: Accused purchased motorcycle with genuine registration book unaware it was stolen. Acquitted under Section 411 PPC.
urdu_ratio: مسروقہ مال رکھنے (411) پر سزا کے لیے ضروری ہے کہ ملزم جانتا ہو کہ وہ مال چوری کا ہے۔ نیک نیتی سے خریداری پر جرم نہیں بنتا۔

case_title: The State v. Muhammad Imran (Zainab Murder Case Confirmation)
ratio_decidendi: In heinous offences of abduction, rape (Section 376 PPC), and murder of minors, DNA profiling evidence conducted by accredited forensic laboratory supported by CCTV footage constitutes conclusive scientific evidence sufficient to sustain capital punishment.
facts_summary: Accused abducted, raped, and murdered 6-year-old child. Supreme Court confirmed four death sentences based on conclusive DNA evidence.
urdu_ratio: بچوں کے اغوا، زیادتی (376) اور قتل کے مقدمات میں تصدیق شدہ ڈی این اے (DNA) اور سائنسی شواہد سزائے موت کے لیے حتمی ثبوت ہیں۔

ratio_decidendi: The two-finger virginity test and hymen examination conducted on rape survivors is unscientific, illegal, and unconstitutional, violating fundamental rights to bodily integrity, personal liberty, and dignity under Articles 9 and 14 of the Constitution.
facts_summary: Supreme Court declared virginity testing in rape trials completely illegal and banned its practice nationwide.
urdu_ratio: زیادتی کی شکار خواتین کا ورجنٹی ٹیسٹ غیر سائنسی، غیر قانونی اور آئین کے آرٹیکل 9 اور 14 (عزتِ نفس) کے خلاف قرار دے کر ممنوع کر دیا گیا۔

ratio_decidendi: In hurt cases under Section 337 PPC, the trial court must convict the accused strictly according to the statutory medical classification of the injury (Shajjah-i-Khafifah, Mudihah, Hashimah, etc.) as established by the Medico-Legal Certificate (MLC). Awarding generalized punishment without specific injury classification is illegal.
facts_summary: Trial court awarded sentence under Section 337 without specifying sub-clause. Supreme Court remanded for proper sentence under correct sub-section.
urdu_ratio: زدوکوب اور چوٹ کے مقدمات (337) میں سزا میڈیکل رپورٹ میں دی گئی مخصوص چوٹ کی درجہ بندی (شجہ، جرح) کے عین مطابق ہونی چاہیے۔

ratio_decidendi: To constitute the capital offence under Section 354-A PPC (assault or use of criminal force to woman and stripping her of clothes in public view), prosecution must prove accused stripped woman naked to expose her to public view. Tearing of clothes during scuffle without intent to strip falls under Section 354 PPC carrying lesser punishment.
facts_summary: During land fight clothes of woman were torn. Supreme Court altered conviction from 354-A PPC to 354 PPC.
urdu_ratio: دفعہ 354-A کے لیے سرعام برہنہ کرنے کی نیت ثابت ہونا ضروری ہے، لڑائی میں کپڑے پھٹ جانے پر دفعہ 354 لاگو ہوگی۔

case_title: Justice Qazi Faez Isa v. President of Pakistan
ratio_decidendi: Article 10A guarantees the fundamental right to a fair trial and due process in the determination of civil rights and obligations or in any criminal charge. Any state action or surveillance without judicial warrant violates Articles 9, 10A, and 14.
facts_summary: Full court judgment upholding judicial independence and strict observance of due process under Article 10A.
urdu_ratio: آئین کا آرٹیکل 10A ہر شہری کو شفاف اور منصفانہ ٹرائل کا بنیادی حق دیتا ہے۔ عدالتی حکم کے بغیر کی گئی ریاستی کارروائی غیر آئینی ہے۔

case_title: Ghulam Hussain v. Station House Officer (SHO)
ratio_decidendi: The High Court under Article 199 has constitutional authority to protect citizens against unlawful police harassment and illegal confinement. However, for registration of an FIR, citizen should first approach Ex-Officio Justice of Peace under Section 22-A / 22-B CrPC.
facts_summary: Supreme Court guidelines for High Courts in entertaining Article 199 petitions against police authorities.
urdu_ratio: آئین کے آرٹیکل 199 کے تحت ہائی کورٹ پولیس کی غیر قانونی ہراسانی کے خلاف شہریوں کو تحفظ فراہم کرنے کی مکمل مجاز ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: The fundamental rights to freedom of speech (Article 19), movement (Article 15), and peaceful assembly (Article 16) must be exercised without infringing rights of other citizens. Blocking public highways and disrupting public life violates constitutional rights of general public.
facts_summary: Landmark verdict on political protests, hate speech, and balance of fundamental rights under the Constitution.
urdu_ratio: آزادیٔ اظہار (آرٹیکل 19) اور اجتماع (آرٹیکل 16) کا حق دوسرے شہریوں کے بنیادی حقوق اور راستے میں رکاوٹ ڈالے بغیر استعمال کرنا لازمی ہے۔

case_title: Mukhtar Ahmad Ali v. Registrar Supreme Court
ratio_decidendi: Article 19A of the Constitution guarantees every citizen the fundamental right to access information in all matters of public importance as a cornerstone of democratic accountability. Public institutions, including judiciary, are accountable to citizens.
facts_summary: Petitioner sought official administrative details regarding public appointments. Supreme Court upheld right to information.
urdu_ratio: آئین کا آرٹیکل 19A ہر شہری کو عوامی اہمیت کے تمام معاملات میں معلومات تک رسائی (Right to Information) کا حق دیتا ہے۔

case_title: Tayyaba Gul v. Director General NAB
ratio_decidendi: The dignity of man and privacy of home under Article 14 is an absolute, non-negotiable fundamental right. Torture or coercive methods in police custody violate Article 14 and render forced confession inadmissible.
facts_summary: Supreme Court established strict prohibitions against physical and psychological coercion by investigating authorities during custody.
urdu_ratio: آرٹیکل 14 کے تحت انسان کی عزتِ نفس کا تقدس لازمی ہے۔ دورانِ حراست تشدد سختی سے ممنوع اور اعتراف ناقابلِ قبول ہے۔

case_title: Asghar Leghari v. Federation of Pakistan
ratio_decidendi: The right to life under Article 9 of the Constitution is not merely confined to vegetative existence; it includes the right to a clean, healthy, and pollution-free environment, access to potable water, and protection against climate vulnerabilities.
facts_summary: Supreme Court directed enforcement of climate change policy framework to protect fundamental right to life under Article 9.
urdu_ratio: آرٹیکل 9 کے تحت حقِ زندگی میں صاف ستھرا ماحول، پینے کا صاف پانی اور موسمیاتی تبدیلیوں سے تحفظ کا حق شامل ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Where the offence does not fall within the prohibitory clause of Section 497(1) CrPC and no exceptional circumstances exist, bail must be granted as a rule.
facts_summary: Accused in custody for over 6 months in non-prohibitory offence.
urdu_ratio: جب جرم امتناعی شق میں نہ آئے تو ضمانت منظور کرنا بنیادی عدالتی اصول ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Pre-arrest bail is confirmed when physical arrest is intended solely for humiliation and recovery can be effected through join-in investigation.
facts_summary: Property boundary conflict with complainant.
urdu_ratio: اگر گرفتاری کا مقصد تذلیل ہو تو قبل از گرفتاری ضمانت کی توثیق کی جائے گی۔

ratio_decidendi: Doubt at bail stage must be resolved in favour of the accused by granting post-arrest bail under Section 497(2) CrPC.
facts_summary: Conflicting eyewitness statements regarding firearm injury.
urdu_ratio: ضمانت کے مرحلے پر کسی بھی شک کا فائدہ ملزم کو ضمانت کی صورت میں ملے گا۔

ratio_decidendi: In offences punishable with imprisonment under 10 years, custody exceeding one year without trial entitles accused to statutory bail.
facts_summary: Trial adjourned 15 times due to prosecutor absence.
urdu_ratio: 10 سال سے کم سزا والے جرائم میں 1 سال سے زائد قید پر قانونی ضمانت لازمی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: In a case of circumstantial evidence, all links in the chain must be complete and unbroken; a single missing link snaps the chain, entitling accused to acquittal.
facts_summary: No eyewitness; prosecution relied on last seen evidence.
urdu_ratio: قرائنی شہادت میں تمام کڑیوں کا جڑا ہونا لازمی ہے، ایک کڑی بھی ٹوٹے تو بریت ہوگی۔

ratio_decidendi: Sudden fight in the heat of passion upon a sudden quarrel without premeditation falls under Exception 4 to Section 300 PPC, punishable under Section 304 Part I PPC.
facts_summary: Graver provocation led to spontaneous brawl.
urdu_ratio: اچانک لڑائی اور بغیر پیشگی منصوبے کے ہونے والے قتل پر سزائے موت کی بجائے تعزیر لاگو ہوگی۔

ratio_decidendi: Extra-judicial confession is a very weak type of evidence and cannot form the sole basis of conviction unless corroborated by unimpeachable independent evidence.
facts_summary: Accused allegedly confessed before village elders.
urdu_ratio: عدالت سے باہر کیا گیا اعتراف (Extra-Judicial Confession) کمزور ترین ثبوت ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Under Section 154 CrPC, police officer is bound to register an FIR upon information disclosing commission of a cognizable offence without preliminary inquiry.
facts_summary: Police refused FIR alleging dispute was civil.
urdu_ratio: قابلِ دست اندازی جرم کی اطلاع پر پولیس سیکشن 154 کے تحت ایف آئی آر درج کرنے کی پابند ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Lapses and deliberate omissions in police investigation must enure to the benefit of the accused, not the prosecution.
facts_summary: IO failed to preserve crime scene fingerprints.
urdu_ratio: پولیس تفتیش کی خامیاں اور نقائص کا فائدہ ہمیشہ ملزم کو ملتا ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Cheque must be proved to have been issued dishonestly towards fulfillment of a valid legal obligation for offence under Section 489-F PPC.
facts_summary: Cheque dishonored on insufficient funds in commercial dealing.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 489-F کے لیے قانونی ذمہ داری کی ادائیگی اور بدنیتی ثابت ہونا ضروری ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: In house theft cases, recovered property must be identified by the complainant during proper identification test proceedings.
facts_summary: Stolen electronic goods recovered without test identification.
urdu_ratio: چوری شدہ مال کی شناخت باقاعدہ قانونی طریقے سے ہونا ضروری ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Principle of natural justice (audi alteram partem - no one should be condemned unheard) is an integral facet of Article 10A of the Constitution.
facts_summary: Executive notification issued without hearing affected parties.
urdu_ratio: کسی بھی شہری کو سنے بغیر سزا یا فیصلہ سنانا آرٹیکل 10A کے خلاف ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Article 25 guarantees equality before law and equal protection of law; arbitrary classifications by the state violate fundamental rights.
facts_summary: Discriminatory quota policy challenged.

facts_summary: Graver provocation led to spontaneous brawl.

ratio_decidendi: Extra-judicial confession is a very weak type of evidence and cannot form the sole basis of conviction unless corroborated by unimpeachable independent evidence.
facts_summary: Accused allegedly confessed before village elders.
urdu_ratio: عدالت سے باہر کیا گیا اعتراف (Extra-Judicial Confession) کمزور ترین ثبوت ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Under Section 154 CrPC, police officer is bound to register an FIR upon information disclosing commission of a cognizable offence without preliminary inquiry.
facts_summary: Police refused FIR alleging dispute was civil.
urdu_ratio: قابلِ دست اندازی جرم کی اطلاع پر پولیس سیکشن 154 کے تحت ایف آئی آر درج کرنے کی پابند ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Lapses and deliberate omissions in police investigation must enure to the benefit of the accused, not the prosecution.
facts_summary: IO failed to preserve crime scene fingerprints.
urdu_ratio: پولیس تفتیش کی خامیاں اور نقائص کا فائدہ ہمیشہ ملزم کو ملتا ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Cheque must be proved to have been issued dishonestly towards fulfillment of a valid legal obligation for offence under Section 489-F PPC.
facts_summary: Cheque dishonored on insufficient funds in commercial dealing.
urdu_ratio: سیکشن 489-F کے لیے قانونی ذمہ داری کی ادائیگی اور بدنیتی ثابت ہونا ضروری ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: In house theft cases, recovered property must be identified by the complainant during proper identification test proceedings.
facts_summary: Stolen electronic goods recovered without test identification.
urdu_ratio: چوری شدہ مال کی شناخت باقاعدہ قانونی طریقے سے ہونا ضروری ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Principle of natural justice (audi alteram partem - no one should be condemned unheard) is an integral facet of Article 10A of the Constitution.
facts_summary: Executive notification issued without hearing affected parties.
urdu_ratio: کسی بھی شہری کو سنے بغیر سزا یا فیصلہ سنانا آرٹیکل 10A کے خلاف ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Article 25 guarantees equality before law and equal protection of law; arbitrary classifications by the state violate fundamental rights.
facts_summary: Discriminatory quota policy challenged.
urdu_ratio: آرٹیکل 25 کے تحت تمام شہری قانون کے سامنے برابر ہیں اور امتیازی سلوک غیر آئینی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Where the offence does not fall within the prohibitory clause of Section 497(1) CrPC and no exceptional circumstances exist, bail must be granted as a rule.
facts_summary: Accused in custody for over 6 months in non-prohibitory offence.
urdu_ratio: جب جرم امتناعی شق میں نہ آئے تو ضمانت منظور کرنا بنیادی عدالتی اصول ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: Pre-arrest bail is confirmed when physical arrest is intended solely for humiliation and recovery can be effected through join-in investigation.
facts_summary: Property boundary conflict with complainant.
urdu_ratio: اگر گرفتاری کا مقصد تذلیل ہو تو قبل از گرفتاری ضمانت کی توثیق کی جائے گی۔

ratio_decidendi: Doubt at bail stage must be resolved in favour of the accused by granting post-arrest bail under Section 497(2) CrPC.
facts_summary: Conflicting eyewitness statements regarding firearm injury.
urdu_ratio: ضمانت کے مرحلے پر کسی بھی شک کا فائدہ ملزم کو ضمانت کی صورت میں ملے گا۔

ratio_decidendi: In offences punishable with imprisonment under 10 years, custody exceeding one year without trial entitles accused to statutory bail.
facts_summary: Trial adjourned 15 times due to prosecutor absence.
urdu_ratio: 10 سال سے کم سزا والے جرائم میں 1 سال سے زائد قید پر قانونی ضمانت لازمی ہے۔

ratio_decidendi: In a case of circumstantial evidence, all links in the chain must be complete and unbroken; a single missing link snaps the chain, entitling accused to acquittal.
facts_summary: No eyewitness; prosecution relied on last seen evidence.
urdu_ratio: قرائنی شہادت میں تمام کڑیوں کا جڑا ہونا لازمی ہے، ایک کڑی بھی ٹوٹے تو بریت ہوگی۔
